rating_model: regularized Bradley-Terry with a jointly fitted 1500-Elo piecewise-linear Black advantage over no-color baseline matchup average Elo
ci_method: Laplace covariance from regularized color-adjusted Bradley-Terry information, including all piecewise color parameters
move_cap_policy: workspace evaluation: forfeit at move limit
random_bot_note: Uniform-random games use KataGoGameEngine because katago match does not support arbitrary policy bots. They remain in the same blind batch. Move-capped attempts are discarded and replayed without scoring.

batch_policy.rule: maximum-information-gain selection with paired colors until the 95% CI is narrow enough, then one batch of all remaining games sampled in proportion to gain
batch_policy.sampling_selection: with replacement proportional to gain within nucleus
